articles.summary: “The Long Run” showcases a world-record journey powered by Glycan Replenishment Therapy and unmatched determination. Global health and wellness innovator Mannatech is proud to premiere Steve Edwards: The Long Run , an 11-minute short documentary chronicling the unbelievable true story of Steve Edwards—an everyday man turned endurance icon. With over 1,000 official marathons completed in record-setting average times, Edwards’ legacy is one of resilience, quiet determination and the pursuit of human potential. The film debuts globally today, May 21, and is followed by an in-depth interview with Steve Edwards himself following the documentary. It is available to watch free at events.mannatech.com (registration required) and on the company’s Facebook page , beginning at 7:30 p.m. CT. From a modest upbringing in Coventry, England, to three Guinness World Records and a final race that brought a crowd to tears, Steve’s journey defies logic.
